lines.en: label streets20:
scene yumipizza1
: ...and that’s exactly what I fucking hate about cafes!
lines.zh: : ……而这正是我他妈最讨厌咖啡厅的地方！

lines.en: : They’re always worried about like, “Oh, customer this, customer that!” but what about the fucking {i}employees{/i}?
lines.zh: : 他们永远只在乎什么“哦，客人这样，客人那样！”可他妈“{i}员工{/i}”呢？

lines.en: : Like, do they realize that employees are the fucking BACKBONE of businesses like that?!
lines.zh: : 他们知不知道，员工才是这种店他妈的“顶梁柱”？！

lines.en: : Keeping them happy matters more than anything else!
lines.zh: : 让员工开心比什么都重要！

lines.en: : So what if I offered to beat some dude’s face in for trying to scam the store? Shit like that shows {i}dedication!{/i}
lines.zh: : 我就说要替店里把某个想骗钱的家伙揍个满脸开花，那又怎样？那种事正说明我有“{i}干劲{/i}”！

lines.en: : Fucking unreal.
lines.zh: : 真他妈离谱。

lines.en: As you can see, Yumi is still a little upset about not getting the first job she applied to.
lines.zh: 如你所见，Yumi 还在为第一份工作没应聘上而闹情绪。

lines.en: But, in all fairness, I’m sure we can all understand why.
lines.zh: 不过说句公道话，我想大家都能理解为什么。

lines.en: It’s one thing to actually follow through on some of her...problem-solving techniques, but talking about them in a job interview is a completely different matter.
lines.zh: 把她那些……解决问题的手段真的付诸实施是一回事，在面试上把它们讲出来可完全是另一回事。

lines.en: : Well hey. At least you did your best.
lines.zh: : 行啦，嘿。至少你尽力了。

lines.en: : And now you have pizza, so all is well.
lines.zh: : 而且现在你有披萨了，所以一切都好。

lines.en: scene yumipizza2
: Whatever...It’s not like I wanted pizza or anything.
lines.zh: : 随便吧……我又不是想要披萨什么的。

lines.en: : Is this what we’ve come to? Token tsundere lines and complaining about cafes?
lines.zh: : 我们什么时候变成这样了？标准的凑数傲娇台词外加抱怨咖啡厅？

lines.en: scene yumipizza3
: Stop fuckin’ calling me tsundere!
lines.zh: : 别他妈叫我傲娇！

lines.en: : The “dere” part implies that I actually fucking like you which I {i}clearly{/i} do not. I barely even like pizza!
lines.zh: : “娇”那部分意味着我他妈真的喜欢你，而我“{i}显然{/i}”一点都不喜欢。我连披萨都几乎不喜欢！

lines.en: : Okay, now that’s just flat out untrue. Everyone likes pizza.
lines.zh: : 好了，这就纯属睁眼说瞎话了。谁都喜欢吃披萨。

lines.en: scene yumipizza2
: Wow, one more thing preventin' me from fitting in with everyone else. Who woulda guessed?
lines.zh: : 哇，又多了一件让我融不进其他人的事。谁想得到呢？

lines.en: : Insecurities aside, what do you think our next course of action should be?
lines.zh: : 自卑先放一边，你觉得我们下一步该怎么走？

lines.en: scene yumipizza4
: Probably {i}eating{/i} the stupid pizza, dipshit. That’s normally what you do after you buy one.
lines.zh: : 大概是把那份破披萨“{i}吃掉{/i}”吧，蠢货。买了披萨之后一般就是这么干的。

lines.en: : I meant about the job hunt...
lines.zh: : 我是说找工作的事……

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well how the fuck would I know? This was all your idea.
lines.zh: : 我他妈哪知道？这全是你的主意。

lines.en: : Don’t tell me that confidence was all just another front to make yourself look cool?
lines.zh: : 别告诉我，你那股自信也只是为了让自己看起来很酷而装出来的？

lines.en: : Wait, you don’t even have money for the pizza, do you? This was all one big scam, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 等等，你根本连买披萨的钱都没有吧？这一切都是个大骗局，是不是？

lines.en: : I literally paid for this already.
lines.zh: : 我可是已经付过钱了。

lines.en: scene yumipizza5
: Listen, dude...Maybe it’ll be better for both of us if we just fuckin’ stop the job search here.
lines.zh: : 听着，老兄……要是我们他妈就这么把找工作的事停在这儿，对两个人都更好。

lines.en: : We clearly don’t like being around each other and this is only making things worse.
lines.zh: : 我们明显都不喜欢跟对方待在一起，再这么下去只会更糟。

lines.en: : I like being around you, though.
lines.zh: : 可我喜欢跟你待在一起啊。

lines.en: scene yumipizza1
: Well I don’t like being around you! So my idea stands!
lines.zh: : 我可不喜欢跟你待在一起！所以我的提议依然成立！

lines.en: Maybe a new sort of strategy is needed?
lines.zh: 也许该换个新策略了？

lines.en: Yumi is clearly not an average girl, so maybe it’s best to find her a job that...isn’t entirely average to begin with?
lines.zh: Yumi 显然不是个普通的女孩，所以也许最好给她找一份……从一开始就不那么普通的工作？

lines.en: Do people still deliver newspapers? Maybe that’s a thing she can do?
lines.zh: 现在还有人送报纸吗？也许那事她能干？

lines.en: : How do you feel about newspapers?
lines.zh: : 你觉得报纸怎么样？

lines.en: scene yumipizza6
: Huh?
: You know. Like...being a delivery girl.
lines.zh: : 你知道的。就是……当个送报小妹。

lines.en: : I know you’re a fuckin’ dinosaur, but how old do you think {i}I{/i} am?
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}知道你是个他妈的老古董，可你觉得“我”多大？

lines.en: : Isn’t shit like that meant for like, 10 year olds or whatever?
lines.zh: : 那种事不是给十岁小孩干的吗？

lines.en: : I think it’s more about work experience than age. And you have virtually none, so...
lines.zh: : 我觉得这更看重工作经验而不是年龄。而你几乎一点经验都没有，所以……

lines.en: scene yumipizza7
: That’s not true. I’ve been running my own business for almost two years now.
lines.zh: : 才不是。我自己做生意快两年了。

lines.en: : Stealing and selling old TVs doesn’t exactly count as running a business, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 偷旧电视再拿去卖，可算不上做生意，Yumi。

lines.en: : It’s not just TVs. There’s candy too.
lines.zh: : 不只是电视。还有糖。

lines.en: : Sure, a lot of that goes to Chinami, but it’s not like I don’t scam grade[school]ers on their way to class every now and then.
lines.zh: : 当然，很多都进了 Chinami 的肚子，但我偶尔也会在小学生去上课的路上坑他们一笔。

lines.en: : Wait, do you really?
lines.zh: : 等等，你真的干？

lines.en: : Obviously. Who else is gonna fuckin’ buy candy from me? You have any idea how sketchy that looks?
lines.zh: : 当然了。不然还有谁他妈会来买我的糖？你知道那看起来有多可疑吗？

lines.en: : Maybe we just...need to get you a job at a candy store?
lines.zh: : 那我们……干脆给你在糖果店找份工作？

lines.en: scene yumipizza8
: Good luck finding one I haven’t already lifted. Pretty sure I’ve got my picture in almost every convenience store in Kumon-mi at this point.
lines.zh: : 祝你能找到一家我没偷过的。我敢说这会儿 Kumon-mi 几乎每家便利店都贴着我的照片了。

lines.en: : Well how about this...Tell me what sort of job you’d be interested in.
lines.zh: : 那这样吧……跟我说说你想找什么样的工作。

lines.en: : List a few qualities, and I’ll just...try and come up with something suitable.
lines.zh: : 列几条条件，我再来……想办法找个合适的。

lines.en: scene yumipizza6
: You mean like you did with the cafe? That sure worked out well, didn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你是说像咖啡厅那样？那次不是结果好得很吗？

lines.en: : Okay, that wasn’t entirely my fault. I just overestimated your ability.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那也不能全怪我。我只是高估了你的能力。

lines.en: : Oh, fuck off with that. You just wanted to see me embarrass myself.
lines.zh: : 哦，去你的吧。你就是想看我出丑。

lines.en: scene yumipizza8
: But at least I got dinner out of it so...whatever.
lines.zh: : 但至少我混到了一顿晚饭，所以……随便吧。

lines.en: Yumi takes a deep breath and watches a few cars as they drive by.
lines.zh: Yumi 深吸一口气，看着几辆车驶过。

lines.en: We’re in an area of the city that neither of us have really been to before, so I imagine she’s trying to scope out a store she hasn’t been caught stealing from yet.
lines.zh: 我们在城里一个两人都不太熟的地方，所以我猜她大概在物色一家还没被她偷过的店。

lines.en: That or she’s just watching the sunset. But, let’s be real, {i}Yumi{/i} watching the sunset? Come on.
lines.zh: 要么她只是在看夕阳。不过说实话，“{i}Yumi{/i}”会看夕阳？得了吧。

lines.en: : So, any ideas?
lines.zh: : 那么，有什么想法吗？

lines.en: : Somewhere quiet, but like, not too quiet. I guess that’s one thing I’d like.
lines.zh: : 安静点的地方，但也别太安静。我想这是一条。

lines.en: scene yumipizza7
: Also, somewhere I’d be able to eat for free.
lines.zh: : 还有，能让我免费吃东西的地方。

lines.en: : Making money would be nice and all but, being able to save it would be even better.
lines.zh: : 能挣钱当然好，但能把钱存下来更好。

lines.en: : And if I don’t have to pay for food, that’ll be a lot easier.
lines.zh: : 要是吃饭不用花钱，那就容易多了。

lines.en: : That’s...surprisingly pragmatic of you.
lines.zh: : 这……还真是出人意料地务实啊。

lines.en: scene yumipizza3
: The fuck did you just say to me, douchebag?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈刚才跟我说什么，混蛋？！

lines.en: : Yumi, pragmatic means sensible.
lines.zh: : Yumi，务实就是讲道理的意思。

lines.en: scene yumipizza7
: Oh.
: Uhh, thanks then.
lines.zh: : 呃，那谢了。

lines.en: : Right...
: Any other qualities before we start narrowing down the list?
lines.zh: : 在缩小范围之前还有别的条件吗？

lines.en: : We’ve already got...mildly quiet and free food. I think we can do a little better than that.
lines.zh: : 目前有……稍微安静，以及免费的食物。我觉得还能再好一点。

lines.en: scene yumipizza8
: Uhh...I guess somewhere close to Chika’s place would be good.
lines.zh: : 呃……我想离 Chika 家近一点会不错。

lines.en: : It’s kind of shitty having to walk back and forth between districts all the time.
lines.zh: : 老要在各个区之间来回走，挺烦的。

lines.en: : Are you really walking that far every day?
lines.zh: : 你真的每天都走那么远？

lines.en: scene yumipizza4
: You have any idea how hard it is to steal a bus ride? What else am I gonna fuckin’ do?
lines.zh: : 你知道蹭公交车有多难吗？不然我他妈还能怎么办？

lines.en: : I think we need to buy you a pair of shorts or something. I can’t imagine it feels nice to be walking miles in a skirt that long for the entire summer.
lines.zh: : 我觉得得给你买条短裤什么的。整个夏天穿着那么长的裙子走几英里，我想肯定不好受。

lines.en: scene yumipizza3
: Hey! Get back to the fuckin’ topic at hand and stop picturing me without my skirt on!
lines.zh: : 嘿！给我他妈回到正题上，别在那儿幻想我没穿裙子的样子！

lines.en: : I realize that might be pretty fucking difficult for you, but you should probably mind your own business when it comes to what I fucking {i}wear{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我知道这对你来说可能相当困难，但我“{i}穿什么{/i}”这件事，你最好少管闲事。

lines.en: : At least let me have some freedom over that if you’re going to try and control every other aspect of my life.
lines.zh: : 既然你打算控制我生活里的方方面面，至少在这件事上给我点自由吧。

lines.en: : Wow, you really like that skirt, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇，你还真喜欢那条裙子啊？

lines.en: scene yumipizza9
: Oh. My. Fucking. God.
lines.zh: : 哦。我。操。你。妈。

lines.en: : Okay, okay. Moving on.
lines.zh: : 好好好。继续。

lines.en: : Mildly quiet. Free food. Old district.
lines.zh: : 稍微安静。免费的食物。老城区。

lines.en: I scan through countless unimportant memories stored in my brain and try to locate something that might fit Yumi’s qualifications.
lines.zh: 我在脑子里翻遍了无数无关紧要的记忆，想找出一个符合 Yumi 条件的地方。

lines.en: I can’t say I go to the old district all that often, but...
lines.zh: 我得说我不怎么去老城区，不过……

lines.en: There is one place that sticks out in my mind.
lines.zh: 有一个地方倒是让我印象深刻。

lines.en: if ramen10 == True:
But...I already know that Tsuneyo didn’t want to hire Kaori.
lines.zh: 但是……我已经知道 Tsuneyo 不想雇 Kaori 了。

lines.en: And if someone as...suspiciously talented as her wasn’t hired, Yumi’s chances seem pretty slim.
lines.zh: 如果连她那种……可疑地有才华的人都没被录用，Yumi 的机会看起来就很渺茫了。

lines.en: But oh well, I guess.
lines.zh: 不过算了，大概吧。

lines.en: Life is all about failing before figuring out what the right way to do things is.
lines.zh: 人生就是在找到正确的做法之前不断失败。

lines.en: Maybe Yumi just needs to fail again in order to...find motivation or something?
lines.zh: 也许 Yumi 只是需要再失败一次，好……找到动力什么的？

lines.en: : What about the ramen shop?
lines.zh: : 那拉面店怎么样？

lines.en: else:
: What about the ramen shop?
lines.zh: : 那拉面店怎么样？

lines.en: scene yumipizza7
: Ramen shop? What ramen shop?
lines.zh: : 拉面店？什么拉面店？

lines.en: : The one that Chika tried to make us eat at a while back.
lines.zh: : 就是之前 Chika 想让我们去吃的那家。

lines.en: scene yumipizza10
: Oh. That place.
lines.zh: : 哦。那家啊。

lines.en: : Kinda forgot since I was only in there for like, two minutes.
lines.zh: : 都有点忘了，我在里面待了也就两分钟。

lines.en: : But uhh...doesn’t Noodles work there?
lines.zh: : 不过呃……Noodles 不是在那儿打工吗？

lines.en: : No. Noodles is a bird. He doesn’t work.
lines.zh: : 不是。Noodles 是只鸟。它不打工。

lines.en: scene yumipizza6
: Are you high?
lines.zh: : 你嗑药了？

lines.en: : No. But I guess you wouldn’t know the real Noodles anyway.
lines.zh: : 没有。不过反正你也不认识真正的 Noodles。

lines.en: : Again, are you high?
lines.zh: : 再问一遍，你嗑药了？

lines.en: : Again, no. You’re talking about Tsuneyo, right?
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，没有。你说的是 Tsuneyo 吧？

lines.en: scene yumipizza10
: Is that her name? I just know her as the weird girl who talks like a robot.
lines.zh: : 她叫这个名？我只知道她是个说话像机器人的怪女孩。

lines.en: : Yeah, definitely Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 对，肯定是 Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Is it a problem if she works there?
lines.zh: : 她在那里工作会有问题吗？

lines.en: scene yumipizza7
: Well...I mean, it wouldn’t be a {i}problem{/i} if the two of us were to work together...At least she doesn’t say much.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我是说，要是我们两个一起打工，倒也不算什么“{i}问题{/i}”……至少她话不多。

lines.en: : Better than the other new girl, at least. That one’s fucking insane.
lines.zh: : 至少比另一个新来的女生强。那个简直是个疯子。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s a fair assessment of Molly. I worry about her.
lines.zh: : 是啊，对 Molly 这个评价很中肯。我还挺担心她的。

lines.en: : You think I’d be able to handle some place like that?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我能应付得了那种地方吗？

lines.en: : Do you actually want my opinion or is that a rhetorical question?
lines.zh: : 你是真想听我的意见，还是只是随口一问？

lines.en: scene yumipizza10
: I mean it...for real.
lines.zh: : 我是说真的……认真的。

lines.en: : I kind of felt like you just threw me into the fire at the last place, and I’m trying not to get my hopes up again if it’s the same thing this time.
lines.zh: : 我总觉得上一家你是直接把我往火坑里推，所以要是这次也一样，我就不想再抱什么希望了。

lines.en: : Well let me ask you this, did you expect finding a job to be easy?
lines.zh: : 那我问你，你本来以为找工作很容易吗？

lines.en: scene yumipizza11
: Uhh...yeah. Kind of.
lines.zh: : 呃……对。差不多吧。

lines.en: : Chika didn’t have any problem finding one when her mom died. It was like, the first thing she did.
lines.zh: : Chika 她妈去世的时候，找工作一点都没费劲。那几乎是她做的第一件事。

lines.en: : But I feel like people take one look at me and think I’m just going to beat the shit out of them or something.
lines.zh: : 可我总觉得别人看我一眼，就会觉得我随时会把他们揍个半死什么的。

lines.en: : To be fair, saying that you’re going to beat the shit out of them probably doesn’t quell that notion at all.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，说出你要把他们揍个半死这种话，大概一点都打消不了那种印象。

lines.en: : Yeah, it really doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 是啊，确实不能。

lines.en: : But maybe I can try a new approach at this noodle place?
lines.zh: : 不过也许我可以在那家面馆试试新的做法？

lines.en: : You mean...you’re going to act normal?
lines.zh: : 你是说……你要表现得像个正常人？

lines.en: scene yumipizza10
: No harm in trying, right? Not like being myself helped at all last time. The cafe would have been a sweet gig, too.
lines.zh: : 试试也没坏处，对吧？反正上次做自己一点用都没有。而且咖啡厅那份工作本来还挺不错的。

lines.en: : ...Are you tearing up right now?
lines.zh: : ……你现在是在哭吗？

lines.en: : You’re growing up so fast...
lines.zh: : 你长大得好快啊……

lines.en: scene yumipizza3
: Who do you think you are, my dad?! Stop fucking crying, you pussy!
lines.zh: : 你以为你是谁啊，我爸吗？！别他妈哭了，你这个娘炮！

lines.en: : I didn’t mean to, I’m just so proud.
lines.zh: : 我不是故意的，我只是太骄傲了。

lines.en: scene yumipizza12
: I haven’t even fuckin’ done anything yet! At least save your stupid tears for when I’m actually hired!
lines.zh: : 我他妈还什么都没做成呢！把你那愚蠢的眼泪留到我真被录用了再流吧！

lines.en: : {i}If{/i} I’m actually hired, that is. That place is still sketchy as fuck.
lines.zh: : “{i}如果{/i}”我真被录用的话。那地方还是他妈可疑得要命。

lines.en: : Pretty sure it’s the same one a lot of the people I used to chill with would hang out at every night.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，以前跟我混的那帮人每晚都泡在那儿。

lines.en: scene yumipizza13
: Are you going to be there, too?
lines.zh: : 你也会在那儿吗？

lines.en: : Not because I want you there, obviously. But because maybe you could...put a good word in for me or something.
lines.zh: : 显然不是因为我想让你在。只是也许你可以……替我说几句好话什么的。

lines.en: : Noodles seems to like you, so maybe you can help...you know, talk me up or something.
lines.zh: : Noodles 好像挺喜欢你，所以也许你能帮忙……你知道，替我美言几句什么的。

lines.en: : Of course. I’ll be sure to tell Tsuneyo about all of your amazing qualities and qualifications.
lines.zh: : 当然。我一定会跟 Tsuneyo 好好讲讲你那些了不起的品质和资历。

lines.en: scene yumipizza14
: Actually, on second thought, how about you just go fuck yourself and I head over there alone?
lines.zh: : 算了，我再想想，你还是去死吧，我自己过去就行。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine your word would be good for anything even {i}if{/i} Noodles likes you just as much as the rest of your fuckin’ harem.
lines.zh: : {i}就算{/i} Noodles 跟你那他妈的后宫里其他人一样喜欢你，我也不觉得你的话能管什么用。

lines.en: scene black
Yumi and I finish the pizza and I give her a few pointers about how to conduct herself in a job interview.
lines.zh: Yumi 和我吃完披萨，我给她讲了几个面试时该怎么表现的要点。

lines.en: To be honest, I don’t know if any of those pointers will apply to an interview held by someone like Tsuneyo, but...
lines.zh: 老实说，我不知道这些要点对 Tsuneyo 那种人主持的面试有没有用，不过……

lines.en: I guess we’ll just have to wait and see.
lines.zh: 我想我们只能等着瞧了。

lines.en: Yumi and I decide that we’re both tired of talking about job-related stuff and make plans to reconvene at the dorms in the future to strategize.
lines.zh: Yumi 和我都受够了工作相关的话题，于是约好以后在宿舍碰头再商量对策。

lines.en: For now, though, she asks to be left alone and I’m suddenly left wandering around on my own in yet another unfamiliar part of the city...
lines.zh: 不过现在，她要求一个人待着，而我又一次被丢在这座城市又一个陌生的角落里独自闲逛……
